text_block_list.text:
Although there was a strong desire to 
enter the Japan Derby— a minor trouble 
arose right beforehand.
(SKRRT!!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ow...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, looks like I lightly twisted my leg.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is what the feng shui was 
showing... Normally, it might not have 
ended with just this, though.
choice_data_list:
Judging by the look of things, the Nippon 
Derby is...

text_block_list.text:
Due to a mild sprain, she had to forfeit 
the race. In her stead, Copano Rickey—

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text:
And now, bringing you breezy, pop-tastic 
live race broadcasts, it's the UmaTube 
channel, "UmaDash 7"!

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Japanese Derby. And our guest 
is Copano Rickey, an up-and-coming Feng 
Shui Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hello there! Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Super Happy!!

I ended up making an appearance on a 
certain commentary UmaTube channel.

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text:
Rickey-san, jumping right into 
predictions... You might have entered this 
race too, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So I know everyone's capabilities 
well. I also thoroughly researched the 
course beforehand, so my reading should be 
pretty accurate.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now then, looking at this year's Nippon 
Derby... They're calling it a clash of the 
top four, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The race favorite is an 'End Closer'. But 
in the Derby, if you're not relatively 
near the front, you usually won't make it 
in time.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The overall pace is slow. The 
front-runners have a high chance of 
staying ahead. Everything's against me, 
but even so—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The race favorite is in 'Bracket 1, Gate 
1'. White is today's lucky color! Plus--

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The match with the inner track's vibrant 
green is also fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So from a feng shui perspective, I think 
we can push through.

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text:
There are some predictions saying it might 
be tough if she gets boxed into the pack, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I think we can still push 
through. Because whitecap waves are 
stronger than blue surges.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And aside from the Big Four, the girl to 
watch— is Bracket 2, Number 3, the black 
Umamusume, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume in white... When light sits 
behind, the shadow racing ahead is taken 
far too lightly. Keep your eyes peeled and 
watch☆

With Copano Rickey's Feng Shui commentary, 
the broadcast got tremendously lively, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable!? Number 1 takes first place! 
With a tremendous late charge from the far 
outside, she lives up to the crowd's 
expectations!!

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text:
"And the Umamusume recommended by 
Rickey-san, Gate 3 in Bracket 2, is—"

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text:
3rd place! She takes 3rd place! Setting 
the pace from the start and stubbornly 
holding on, she's shown strength far 
beyond her odds!

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text: Rickey-san, how did you know!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal, really. I just added up 
their ability and luck, and chose the 
Umamusume with the best total.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"If you align your environment, you can 
invite happiness—whether you're the girl 
in 1st, the girl in 3rd, or anyone 
watching the channel! That's feng shui☆"

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that's kinda incredible! I feel like 
I've witnessed the true power of Feng 
Shui!

text_block_list.name: Play-by-Play MC
text_block_list.text:
Rickey-san, please be sure to come visit 
again!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, with pleasure☆
And a few days after the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer! Look, look at that shop 
over there!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Look at all those people at the feng shui 
shop! I've never seen it this crowded 
before~

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, aren't stones like this so 
pretty and nice? Apparently, getting your 
lucky color is the way to go.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll go buy a book. I want to find 
out what kind of things I should put by my 
pillow."

The shop was bustling with crowds of 
customers. There were even massive banners 
set up—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That banner says... let's see— 'Trending 
now thanks to Copano Rickey! The 
miraculous power of Feng Shui!'

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I'm glad it got people talking, 
but 'Miraculous Feng Shui Power!' is 
laying it on a bit thick, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I would've preferred a more 
relaxed vibe, like... if you make the 
right feng shui preparations, your luck 
will naturally improve.

"There's definitely quite a bit of 
exaggeration in it. Still, it was way 
better than being ignored."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I guess this is the Japanese Derby effect. 
The amount of attention on us is 
completely on another level compared to 
usual☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If only this gets everyone to take even a 
little interest in feng shui!
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, look, look! At this letter☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Look at this: 'I tried Rickey's Feng 
Shui, and it made me feel a lot more 
positive! I'm totally a huge fan now♪'!"
choice_data_list: Oh, I'm glad to hear that!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can feel it~ That the feng shui is 
steadily... passing on our wish for 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, keep it up! The season moves from 
Lesser Fullness to Grain in Ear. And then 
into fruitful summer♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Spread far and wide, my feng shui☆

—Running in the major race, the Japanese 
Derby, was not to be. But with the 
prediction coming true, rumors about the 
feng shui rapidly spread far and wide.
